warnings: Axes: x = 1-4 (4.00 each); y = A-D (4.00 each) — an L-shaped plan: row D exists only under bay 1-2 (the mirror image of ไทยพอเพียง 4). Origin A1.

Two lines are not dimensioned on the S sheets and were measured by proportion against the grid, both flagged: the main roof's ridge row (y 2.00, 0.10 past the printed beam line A'' at 1.90) and the wing's ridge (x 2.00, 0.10 past the B1 line at 1.90). Kept as separate lines from the beam lines rather than merged.
The F2 detail on S-05 is drawn rotated 90°: building 1.30 along x × 1.00 along y, piles on C''.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget for this batch) — z_levels holds only the ground datum printed on the S sheets.
